summary_1line: Arjuna devastates the Kuru army with unstoppable archery, then directs his charioteer Uttara toward key warriors including Kripa, Drona, Duryodhana, Karna, and Bhishma.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands on his chariot drawing the Gandiva into a perfect circle as countless arrows streak through the sky, elephants below bristling like black clouds pierced by sunrays.
Karna reels as a bearded arrow pierces his ear while his shattered chariot and fallen horses collapse amid the chaos of battle.
The sky above the battlefield fills with gods, Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Nagas in celestial chariots watching the impending clash of Arjuna and Bhishma.
